diff --git a/prefs.py b/prefs.py
index ea1caf8..2d06599 100644
--- a/prefs.py
+++ b/prefs.py
@@ -26,5 +26,12 @@ def save(path, prefs):
 
 
 def reset(prefs):
-    """Preferences after the user presses 'Reset to defaults'."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    """Preferences after the user presses 'Reset to defaults'.
+
+    Theme, font size, autosave interval and line numbers go back to the
+    defaults. The user's chosen language is kept. Returns a new dict and does
+    not save anything.
+    """
+    result = dict(DEFAULTS)
+    result["language"] = prefs.get("language", DEFAULTS["language"])
+    return result
diff --git a/tests/test_prefs.py b/tests/test_prefs.py
index 574c92e..e809185 100644
--- a/tests/test_prefs.py
+++ b/tests/test_prefs.py
@@ -11,3 +11,27 @@ def test_save_and_load_keeps_changes(tmp_path):
     loaded = prefs.load(p)
     assert loaded["theme"] == "dark"
     assert loaded["font_size"] == prefs.DEFAULTS["font_size"]
+
+
+def test_reset_restores_defaults_but_keeps_language():
+    changed = {
+        "theme": "dark",
+        "font_size": 20,
+        "language": "es",
+        "autosave_minutes": 1,
+        "show_line_numbers": True,
+    }
+    result = prefs.reset(changed)
+    assert result == {**prefs.DEFAULTS, "language": "es"}
+
+
+def test_reset_without_language_uses_default_language():
+    assert prefs.reset({"theme": "dark"}) == prefs.DEFAULTS
+
+
+def test_reset_does_not_modify_defaults_or_input():
+    changed = {"theme": "dark", "language": "es"}
+    result = prefs.reset(changed)
+    result["theme"] = "blue"
+    assert prefs.DEFAULTS["theme"] == "light"
+    assert changed == {"theme": "dark", "language": "es"}
